Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our DPA redline review we're trying to be explicit about what constitutes 'proof of purge' for customer data and what the operational timelines are for ephemeral caches/backups/snapshots. A few quick clarifying asks so we can finalize Annex B: 

- What evidence artifacts can Redwood provide on request (e.g., deletion job run logs, cryptographic deletion markers, backup retention metadata)?
- Do you include backup/snapshot lifecycle events in the same erase SLA or are they treated as a separate process?
- For urgent legal holds, do you have an on-call playbook that ensures an immediate suspension of deletion and an audit trail that we can consume?

We have attached a simple evidence template (Acme_evidence_template.xlsx) to show the format our auditors expect — if you can map your outputs to those columns that would help speed legal review.

Also: we need to confirm whether KV/cache purges can be certificated within 24 hours or whether there is a longer operational window.

Can you confirm by EOD tomorrow? If easier we can take a short call.

Thanks,
J. Castillo
Senior Counsel, Acme Corp

Hi J.,

Appreciate the clear template — very helpful. High level answers below, then Ill loop in Lauren and Ben for the suggested DPA wording and operational clarifications.

Summary answers (high level):
- Evidence artifacts we can provide: deletion job run logs (timestamped), retention/backup metadata (TTL and snapshot IDs), KV cache invalidation events, and optional signed runbook confirmation for agreed escalations. We can also provide a consolidated evidence bundle in PDF/CSV form.
- Backups & snapshots: treated as part of the broader erase workflow but handled via a separate subsystem; we can commit to an erase evidence package that includes snapshot lifecycle events. Typical backup expiration varies by backup type; we propose a 30-day confirmation window for long-term backup purges to allow safe remediation and cross-region syncs.
- On-call playbook: yes, we have an emergency retention hold playbook that pauses scheduled erasures and emits an auditable hold token. We can provide the playbook as an annex and make on-call contact points available under NDA.

Requested next steps:
1) We'll attach our purge evidence checklist (see attached).
2) Lauren will propose precise DPA language for Annex B to describe the evidence bundle and timelines.
3) Ben will confirm the KV/cache purging window and whether 24-hour certification is operationally feasible for your use case.

Happy to take a 30-minute call tomorrow if you prefer to walk through the template.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Fwd: DPA: proof-of-purge & emergency retention exceptions (internal)

Thanks Steph. Draft language below for Annex B — this is intentionally tight but provides the artifacts they asked for. Happy to iterate.

"Annex B  Proof of Purge
Redwood shall provide, upon request, an evidence package demonstrating the deletion of Customer Data. The evidence package will include: (a) deletion job execution logs with timestamps and unique job identifiers; (b) snapshot and backup lifecycle entries indicating expiration and removal events; (c) KV/cache invalidation records where applicable; and (d) an operational runbook confirmation when an escalated or notarized purge is requested. Evidence packages will be produced within thirty (30) calendar days following the Customer's written request, except for ephemeral in-memory cache invalidations where Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide certification within twenty-four (24) hours.

For clarity, Redwood's provision of an evidence package does not require changes to underlying backup retention policies unless expressly agreed in writing and subject to an SOW or additional fees.

"

Notes: we should offer an "Annex B - option 2" that shortens the 30-day window for Dedicated/Private customers where we can control backup retention more tightly. Also propose we add a line about fees for notarization

-Lauren
